preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.description: Each character in the return value must appear an odd number of times in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(input_string.rindex(char) == input_string.rindex(return_value[i]) for i, char in enumerate(return_value))
postconditions.description: Each character in the return value must be the last occurrence of that character in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] != return_value[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i + 1, len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: All characters in the return value must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(char in input_string for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each character in the return value must be present in the input string.
